case: A step emits more than one effect, so the step stops being the idempotency unit.
why: Every retry story in 05 section 6 rests on the step being the unit a repeat is judged against. With the count ceiling gone, a step that emitted two effects and is retried repeats an unknown number of them, and the `EffectIdentity` machinery downstream has no unit to reconcile against. Coverage note: F6C-16 measured 14 of 30 guards exercised by a paired adverse and benign fixture, and `guard.effect.one_per_step` was one of the sixteen without one -- a guard registered with no adverse fixture is a guard nobody has seen fail.
